WITH qc_with_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') as fundflux,
    sq.qualregistry
  FROM scanqc sq
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    COUNT(qualregistry) as qc_count
  FROM qc_with_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(qc_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_sources
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.fundflux,
  g.qc_count,
  g.qc_count::float / t.total_count as fraction_of_total,
  g.qc_count::float / (t.total_count::float / t.num_sources) as count_divided_by_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY g.fundflux
